Introduction

Ayatsuno Yuni is a Japanese V-Tuber and singer under Accelers. She is a member of the South Korean V-Tuber group StelLive and a former member of V-Tuber group YumePercent. Originally debuting as a soloist in July, 2023, with the single "How to be mine", she later debuted in StelLive on February 21, 2024, as part of the subunit, 1st Generation 'Mystic'.

Her birth year is unknown, but the date is known to be May 21.
